roster_policy: Eligible station in >=80% of outer-training years for all four physical predictors; roster chosen only from each outer-training window. No hyperparameter tuning in this diagnostic.
qc_policy: Mask temperature and degree-day measurements unless missing_mean_temp_days equals zero; mask precipitation unless missing_precip_days equals zero; snowfall/max/min use respective missing-day fields. Unknown missing-day counts are excluded. This is a complete-day-count sensitivity, not comprehensive source quality certification.
lag_policy: Features from calendar year t-1; use 1987 only as context for 1988; annual labels unchanged. Historical source products remain retrospective, not proof of as-of availability.
interpretation: Use as aggregation/information sensitivity; no best-condition promotion from outer scores. Same-year original serves the matched fixed-hyperparameter control.
